description: This file defines the WorkspaceProviderInterface interface for workspace providers in Drupal, including method signatures for access checks and entity lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: WorkspaceProviderInterface
classes.description: Interface for workspace providers, defining methods for access control and entity lifecycle events.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the workspace provider.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a workspace operation for a given user.

methods.name: entityCreate
methods.description: Hook called before an entity is created.

methods.name: entityPreload
methods.description: Hook called before entities are loaded, allowing modification of entity IDs.

methods.name: entityPresave
methods.description: Hook called before an entity is saved, may throw RuntimeException.

methods.name: entityInsert
methods.description: Hook called after an entity has been inserted.

methods.name: entityUpdate
methods.description: Hook called after an entity has been updated.

methods.name: entityTranslationInsert
methods.description: Hook called after an entity translation has been inserted.

methods.name: entityPredelete
methods.description: Hook called before an entity is deleted, may throw RuntimeException.

methods.name: entityDelete
methods.description: Hook called after an entity has been deleted.

methods.name: entityRevisionDelete
methods.description: Hook called after an entity revision has been deleted.
